notice_1: ^A friend has three lines that will not sit together and needs a second pair of eyes. They are waiting at the Reading Bench.
later_1: ^The notice stays lit. It will be here when you pass again.

b: ^You came back. Tell the table how it went.
^Read the three lines aloud, one at a time. Say which line you would keep. Then say who else here you would ask for help.

notice_2: ^A friend has half a table and no one to hold the other end. They are waiting at the Workbench.
later_2: ^The notice stays lit. It will be here when you pass again.

b: ^You came back. Tell the table how it went.
^Hold the other end of the table. Say what you would build next and who here would enjoy building it with you.

notice_3: ^A friend has a decision they keep circling and wants to say it out loud to one person. They are waiting at the Listening Stone.
later_3: ^The notice stays lit. It will be here when you pass again.

b: ^You came back. Tell the table how it went.
^Sit beside them and listen without fixing. When they stop, say back the one thing you heard.
